core_obligations: Compute the tensor product with the colimit (proof lines 3160-3167): because the colimit is taken termwise, colim_i Tot(F^bullet tensor K_i^bullet) = Tot(F^bullet tensor colim_i K_i^bullet) for every test complex F^bullet.

Test K-flatness (proof lines 3167-3169): by the definition, it suffices to show that Tot(F^bullet tensor colim_i K_i^bullet) is acyclic whenever F^bullet is acyclic, and by the displayed identity that total complex is the colimit of the complexes Tot(F^bullet tensor K_i^bullet).

Conclude (proof lines 3168-3169): each Tot(F^bullet tensor K_i^bullet) is acyclic because K_i^bullet is K-flat, and filtered colimits are exact, so the colimit is acyclic, which is the K-flatness of colim_i K_i^bullet.
proof_roadmap: Use the termwise description of the colimit to commute the total tensor product with the colimit.
Test K-flatness against an acyclic complex F^bullet.
Each member of the colimit system is acyclic by K-flatness of K_i^bullet.
Filtered colimits are exact, so the colimit is acyclic, which proves K-flatness.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a filtered colimit of K-flat complexes of O-modules on a ringed site is K-flat (statement lines 3151-3157). The proof is a two-step reduction: because the colimit of complexes is taken termwise, the total tensor product commutes with it, colim_i Tot(F^bullet tensor K_i^bullet) = Tot(F^bullet tensor colim_i K_i^bullet) (proof lines 3160-3167), and testing against an acyclic F^bullet each member of the system is acyclic by K-flatness, so exactness of filtered colimits gives acyclicity of the colimit (proof lines 3167-3169). The content is the termwise commutation of the tensor product with the colimit together with exactness of filtered colimits. The claim is H2: one displayed identity plus one standard exactness property.
